question: $\int \frac{3}{2-5 x} d x=f(x)+c$ হলে $f(x)$ এর মান কোনটি?
explanation:
$ \int \frac{3}{2-5 \mathrm{x}} \mathrm{dx}=\int \frac{3}{-5} \cdot \frac{-5}{2-5 \mathrm{x}} \mathrm{dx} $


$=-\frac{3}{5} \int \frac{1}{(2-5 \mathrm{x})}(-5) \cdot \mathrm{dx}=-\frac{3}{5} \ln (2-5 \mathrm{x})+\mathrm{c}$


$ \therefore f(\mathrm{x}) $ এর মান $=-\frac{3}{5} \ln (2-5 \mathrm{x})$

subject: Math 1st Paper
question:
$f(x)=x, g(x)=\cos x^2 $ হলে


i. $\int \frac{2}{f(x)} d x=2 \ln x+c $


ii. $\int_0^1 2 x g(x) d x=\frac{\pi}{2} $


iii. $g^{\prime}(x)=-2 x \sin x^2$


নিচের কোনটি সঠিক?
explanation:
এখানে, $f(\mathrm{x})=\mathrm{x}, \mathrm{g}(\mathrm{x})=\cos \mathrm{x}^2$


(i) $\int \frac{2}{f(x)} d x=\int \frac{2}{x} d x=2 \int \frac{1}{x} d x=2 \ln x+c$


(ii) $\int_0^1 2 x g(x) d x=\int_0^1 2 x \cos x^2 d x$


$=\int_0^1 \cos x^2\left(d x^2\right)=\left[\sin x^2\right]_0^1=\sin 1-\sin 0=\sin 1 \neq \frac{\pi}{2}$


(iii) $g^{\prime}(x)=\frac{d}{d x}\left(\cos x^2\right)=-\sin x^2 \cdot 2 x=-2 x \sin x^2$


$\therefore$ (i) ও (iii) সঠিক।

question:
$f(x)=x^2 $ এবং $g(x)=\ln x $ হলে-


i. $\int \frac{1}{f(x)} d x=-\frac{1}{x^3}+c$


ii. $g^{\prime}\left(\frac{1}{x}\right)=-\frac{1}{x}$


iii. $\lim _{x \rightarrow 0} \frac{g(1-3 x)}{2 x}=-\frac{3}{2}$


নিচের কোনটি সঠিক?
explanation:
এখানে, $f(\mathrm{x})=\mathrm{x}^2$ এবং $\mathrm{g}(\mathrm{x})=\ln \mathrm{x}$


(i) $\int \frac{1}{f(x)} d x=\int \frac{1}{x^2} d x=\int x^{-2} d x$ $=\frac{x^{-2+1}}{-2+1}+c=-\frac{1}{x}+c$


(ii) $g\left(\frac{1}{x}\right)=\ln \frac{1}{x}$


$\therefore g^{\prime}\left(\frac{1}{x}\right)=\frac{d}{d x}\left(\ln \frac{1}{x}\right)$ $=\frac{1}{\frac{1}{x}} \frac{d}{d x}\left(\frac{1}{x}\right)=x \cdot \frac{d}{d x}\left(x^{-1}\right)$


$=x \cdot(-1) x^{-1-1}=x \cdot(-1) \cdot x^{-2}$


$=-x \cdot x^{-2}=-x^{-2+1}=-x^{-1}=-\frac{1}{x}$


(iii) $\lim _{x \rightarrow 0} \frac{g(1-3 x)}{2 x}$ $=\lim _{x \rightarrow 0} \frac{\ln (1-3 x)}{2 x}$


$=\lim _{x \rightarrow 0} \frac{\frac{1}{1-3 x} \cdot(-3)}{2 \cdot 1}$ [By LHopital rule]


$=\frac{\frac{-3}{1}}{2}=-\frac{3}{2}$


$\therefore$ (ii) ও (iii) সঠিক।

question: $\int \frac{d x}{\sqrt{x^2-a^2}}= কত? $
explanation:
ধরি, $x=a \sec \theta$

বা, $x^2=a^2 \sec ^2 \theta$

বা, $x^2=a^2\left(1+\tan ^2 \theta\right)$

বা, $x^2=a^2+a^2 \tan ^2 \theta$

বা, $\sqrt{\mathrm{x}^2-\mathrm{a}^2}=\mathrm{a} \tan \theta$

আবার, $\mathrm{x}=\mathrm{a} \sec \theta$

$\therefore$ (i) ও (iii) সঠিক।


$\int \frac{d x}{\mathrm{d} \theta\sqrt{x^2-a^2}} d x=\int \frac{a \sec \theta \cdot \tan \theta}{a \tan \theta}$

$ =\int \sec \theta d \theta $

$=\ln |\sec \theta+\tan \theta|+c_1 $

$=\ln \left|\frac{x}{a}+\frac{\sqrt{x^2-a^2}}{a}\right|+c_1 $

$=\ln \left|\frac{x+\sqrt{x^2-a^2}}{a}\right|+c_1$

$=\ln \left|x+\sqrt{x^2-a^2}\right|-\ln a+c_1$

$=\ln \left|x+\sqrt{x^2-a^2}\right|+c\left[\because c=c_1-\ln a\right]$

i. $\int g({x\over 2})dx=-2cot{x\over 2}+c$

iii. $\int f(x)g(x)dx=-{1\over 2}cot^2x+c$


নিচের কোনটি সঠিক?
explanation:
i. $\int g\left(\frac{x}{2}\right) d x$

$=\int \operatorname{cosec}^2\left(\frac{x}{2}\right) d x=\frac{-\cot \frac{x}{2}}{\frac{1}{2}}+c=-2 \cot \frac{x}{2}+c$

iii. $\int f(x) g(x) d x=\int \cot x \operatorname{cosec}^2 x d x$

ধরি,

$\begin{aligned}& \cot x=z \\& \Rightarrow-\operatorname{cosec}^2 x=\frac{d z}{d x} \\& \therefore \operatorname{cosec}^2 x d x=-d z\end{aligned}$

$\begin{aligned} & =\int z(-d z) \\ & =-\frac{z^2}{2}+c \\ & =\frac{-1}{2} \cot ^2 x+c\end{aligned}$
